about_the_game:
The official soundtrack to Asteroid Requiem — a quiet sci-fi game about memory, collapse, and drifting through space.

This 4-track release features ambient electronic compositions with subtle hints of retro arcade texture. Each piece reflects a moment in the journey: from a second chance, to falling back to Earth.

Includes high quality FLAC files.
